title: GDPR & CCPA Privacy Policy for Grandma Recipe
contentHtml:
Effective Date: 14/06/2025
Last Updated : 29/10/2025

I’m Grandma Millie, and I hope this cozy kitchen corner feels like home—full of love, laughter, and recipes passed down from flour-dusted counters and handwritten cards, like my famous cinnamon rolls, chicken pot pie, and can’t-ever-change-the-recipe biscuits.
>> See more about me

At Grandma Recipe, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

Your use of our website signifies your acceptance of the practices described in this policy.

Information We Collect

We collect the following types of information when you visit or interact with our website:

Personal Information

  • Name (if provided through contact forms or comments)
  • Email address (if you subscribe to our newsletter or contact us)
  • IP address
  • Any other information you voluntarily provide

Automatically Collected Data

  • Log files (browser type, referring/exit pages, time spent on the site)
  • Cookies and tracking technologies (see “Cookies & Tracking Technologies” section)

Third-Party Data Collection

We may use third-party services such as Google Analytics, advertising networks, and affiliate programs that collect additional information about your browsing behavior.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information for the following purposes:

  • To improve our website and user experience
  • To personalize content and recipe recommendations
  • To send newsletters and updates (only if you opt-in)
  • To analyze website traffic and user interactions
  • To comply with legal requirements

GDPR – Your Rights (For EU Users)

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you are entitled to the following rights concerning your personal data:

  • Right to Access – Request a copy of the data we have about you.
  • Right to Rectification – Correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Right to Erasure – Request the deletion of your personal data.
  • Right to Restrict Processing – Limit how we use your data.
  • Right to Data Portability – Request your data in a structured format.
  • Right to Object – Opt out of certain processing, such as marketing emails.
  • Right to Lodge a Complaint – You can file a complaint with your local data protection authority.

📧 To exercise your GDPR rights, contact us at: contact@grandmarecipe.com

CCPA – Your Rights (For California Residents)

In compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California residents have the following rights:

  • Right to Know – Request details about the personal data we collect, use, and share.
  • Right to Delete – Ask us to delete your personal data.
  • Right to Opt-Out – Decline the sale or sharing of personal information.
  • Right to Non-Discrimination – You won’t be treated unfairly for exercising your privacy rights.

📧 To exercise your CCPA rights, contact us at: contact@grandmarecipe.com
Please use the subject line: “CCPA Request.”

Data Sharing & Third-Party Services

Your personal information is never sold. However, we may share data with trusted third-party partners, such as:

  • Service providers (e.g., email platforms, hosting providers)
  • Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics)
  • Affiliate networks (e.g., Amazon Associates)
  • Advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta, Pinterest)

These third parties have their own privacy policies, which we recommend reviewing.

Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Cookies and similar technologies are used to enhance your browsing experience.

Types of Cookies:

  • Essential Cookies – Necessary for website functionality
  • Performance Cookies – Track user behavior for analytics
  • Marketing Cookies – Used for personalized advertising

Managing Cookies:

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect your experience on our site.

Data Retention

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law. You may request the deletion of your data at any time, and we will comply unless legally obligated to retain it.

Security Measures

We use standard security practices to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. While we strive to protect your information, no online system is completely secure.

Third-Party Links

Our site may include links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy policies or content of those third-party sites. Please review their privacy practices before sharing personal data.

Updates to This Privacy Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. All changes will be posted on this page with a new “Effective Date.” Continued use of our website indicates your agreement to the updated terms.

For more details, please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this GDPR & CCPA Privacy Policy, you can reach us at:

📧 Email: contact@grandmarecipe.com
🌍 Website: https://www.grandmarecipe.com
